strings.По валидирани скали и изследвания: Built on validated scales and research
strings.Тук няма въпроси за храна. Питаме как ми: There are no questions about food here. We ask how your ordinary days go, and from that we learn what food does for you.
strings.Неприятно съобщение вечер, празна неделя: An unpleasant message at night, an empty Sunday, a mistake at work. One tap each, about three minutes.
strings.Накрая — портрет и план: At the end: a portrait and a plan
strings.Какво се вижда от отговорите, какво знач: What your answers show, what it means for your eating, and three concrete things for the week.
Built on established scales and research.
strings.Какво е емоционалното хранене и как се п: What emotional eating is and how it shows up
strings.Импулсът и чувствата: най-силните предик: Impulse and feelings: the strongest predictors
strings.Сигналите на тялото и вътрешният глас: Body signals and the inner voice
strings.Подходи с доказан ефект в съветите: Approaches with proven effect behind the advice
strings.Четиринайсет черти, които изследванията: Fourteen traits that research links to eating when feelings run high: acting right away on a strong feeling (UPPS-P), recognising feelings (TAS-20, DERS), escaping unpleasant thoughts, all-or-nothing thinking and strict rules (restraint theory), the harsh inner voice (FSCRS), closeness and loneliness, boredom, the quick reward, body signals (MAIA-2), comfort learned in childhood, sleep and tiredness.
strings.Със сцени от обикновени дни, без въпроси: Through scenes from ordinary days, with no questions about food. When the topic is food, people tense up and answer as the person they want to be. About anything else, they answer freely. Most choices are between equally acceptable answers, a principle that guards against putting on a good show. Mirrored pairs of questions check that the answers are consistent.
strings.Всеки отговор натоварва една или няколко: Each answer loads one or more traits, weighted by how strong the link is in research. Acting on a strong feeling weighs the most, because it is the strongest predictor. The profile is the closest pattern by similarity. Scenes adapt to gender and age, and teenagers get their own scenes and no weight-loss advice at all.
strings.Само подходи с доказан ефект: редовно хр: Only approaches with proven effect: regular meals and no compensating (CBT), a pause between the feeling and the action (DBT), naming the feeling, a kinder inner voice, “if… then…” plans instead of bans. Actions are chosen by cause, not the same for everyone.
strings.Когато отговорите показват силна строгос: When the answers show strong self-criticism and all-or-nothing thinking, the result calmly suggests talking to a specialist.
